source.ref: Maharashtra Stamp Act, 1958, Sch. I Art. 40(a)
source.quoted_text: Sch I Art. 40(a) (both columns): 'when possession of the property or any part of the property comprised in such deed is given by the mortgagor or agreed to be given — The same duty as is leviable on a conveyance under clauses (a), (b) or (c), as the case may be, of Article 25, for the amount secured by such deed.' Explanation I: a mortgagor giving the mortgagee a POA to collect rents or a lease is deemed to give possession.

notes_for_reviewer: CONFIDENCE: HIGH (official IGR). Area-based Conveyance rate (Art 25) on the amount secured (cross-ref imports the Art 25 charge, incl. the area_type RateSpec, but NOT its women/metro modifiers). PENDING: mortgage IS in the metro-cess instrument list (sale/gift/mortgage) — a metro-city mortgage-with-possession should also attract the 1% cess; attach MH-metro-cess here once the mortgage cess base is confirmed.

source.ref: Maharashtra Stamp Act, 1958, Sch. I Art. 40(b) (subst. by Mah. Act 3 of 2021, w.e.f. 9-2-2021)
source.quoted_text: Sch I Art. 40(b) RAW two-column extraction (AMBIGUOUS — flagged per encoding guardrail): description column '(b) when possession is not given or agreed to be given as aforesaid.' Duty column shows TWO lines: '[0.1 per cent of] the amount secured by such deed, subject to the minimum of one hundred rupees.' AND '0.3 per cent of the amount secured by such deed, subject to the maximum of [twenty lakh rupees]; Provided that, in case of instrument executed in favour of consortium of banks, the duty chargeable shall not exceed fifty lakh rupees.' Footnote: clause (b) substituted by Mah. Act 3 of 2021 (w.e.f. 9-2-2021); PRIOR text was '0.5 percent of the amount secured, minimum one hundred rupees and maximum ten lakh rupees'. Widely-cited current operative figure: 0.3%, max Rs 20 lakh (Rs 50 lakh for a consortium of banks).

notes_for_reviewer: CONFIDENCE: MEDIUM — flagged per the two-column guardrail. The source duty column shows BOTH a '0.1% min Rs 100' line and a '0.3% max Rs 20 lakh' line for clause (b); the operative figure is widely cited as 0.3% (max Rs 20 lakh; Rs 50 lakh for a consortium of banks) post-Mah 3/2021, and that is encoded (with min Rs 100). PENDING_VERIFICATION: confirm the '0.1%' line is not a distinct sub-tier, and the consortium-of-banks Rs 50 lakh cap (a fact-gated cap not yet modelled — currently the flat Rs 20 lakh cap applies). The prior-era version (0.5%, min 100, max 10 lakh, pre-9-Feb-2021) is a back-catalogue item.
